notes: Sheet is mostly Mill Creek and the B&O SW / CC&StL railroad yard. Only platted streets: Willow Street (N-S, x~3637, from the top edge to a dead end at y~2543) and Garrard Avenue (60', x~4730-4745, full height, carrying the Chicago Cincinnati & Louisville R.R. on trestle). Bank, Dayton, Exeter and York are Volume 3 sheet 212 streets drawn in outline at the east edge; each Ts into Garrard from the east (Garrard's west side is the Willow block or open yard). Streets printed without suffix (WILLOW, BANK, DAYTON, EXETER, YORK) recorded as '... Street'. Willow and Garrard both continue north onto sheet 221; Garrard continues south onto sheet 201 (match line A-B at y~6735).
